subject: SilverCrow: Throughput and P99 regression after v4.2 quant flip
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@silvercrow.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.reynolds@silvercrow.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: [SilverCrow] Sudden throughput drop + p99 spike after v4.2 deploy

Hi Rishi,

We flipped to Redwood v4.2 with the int8-fast quant profile at 02:15 PT and immediately saw a ~40% throughput drop and p99 go from ~320ms to ~1.4s. We're also observing intermittent 500s for a subset of requests (roughly 0.6% of calls). This is hitting our checkout flow and producing customer complaints.

Attached is a slice of latency samples from our side (timestamp, route, p50/p95/p99, error). Can someone from Redwood triage urgently?

What we tried so far: routed 20% traffic to fallback model and saw some improvement, but routing controls are limited in the managed rollout. We need an emergency mitigation plan and, if necessary, a rollback to the previous model/version. This is impacting revenue.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of Engineering, SilverCrow
[aisha.khan@silvercrow.com]
[attachment: silvercrow_latency_samples_20260309.csv (12KB)]
From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@silvercrow.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 08:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [SilverCrow] Sudden throughput drop + p99 spike after v4.2 deploy

Hi Aisha — sorry you're seeing this. We're on it.

Quick notes / ask:
- We see the v4.2 + int8-fast rollout in our control plane at 02:12 PT.
- Can you confirm if you were using any custom prefix caching or a changed sequence-length budget in your routing rules?
- Please send any full request/trace ids you have for 500s. If you can share a short timeframe (e.g. 02:15–02:30 PT) traces that would help.

Immediate action I'm proposing:
1) I will open an incident and assign infra to evaluate kernel contention / decoder stalls.
2) Marissa, can you coordinate a traffic shift to fallback v4.1 for SilverCrow (hotpath) while we investigate? We want to limit customer impact.
3) Irene, please pull the KV cache hit rates and memory-allocs for the affected hosts and check for GC/eviction churn.

Aisha, if you want us to perform an emergency rollback to v4.1, confirm and we'll prioritize. Otherwise we'll perform a staged fallback to 100% for as short as possible while we validate.

Rishi
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@silvercrow.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [SilverCrow] Sudden throughput drop + p99 spike after v4.2 deploy

Rishi —
This is urgent. Checkout conversion fell ~12% in the first 30 minutes after the flip. Please escalate to executive on-call and give us a rollback ETA if a staged fallback won't restore traffic immediately.

If you need written approval to do a rollback, consider this message our approval — the business impact is material. We expect Redwood to take emergency action and follow up with an RCA and credits.

We can join a call now. Phone: +1 415 555 0198.

Tom
CTO, SilverCrow
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [SilverCrow] Sudden throughput drop + p99 spike after v4.2 deploy

Looping in infra + ops. Proposed action plan (immediate):
- 10:10 PT: Initiate emergency rollout policy: switch SilverCrow hotpath to model v4.1 (stable) using dedicated routing override. Target: 100% on v4.1 within 10m.
- 10:20 PT: Collect telemetry snapshot (p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization, kernel stalls, queue lengths).
- 10:30 PT: If telemetry indicates p99 back to baseline and 500s resolved, keep v4.1 while we do a quant-profile audit.
- Post-mitigation: schedule a forensic session to compare v4.2 int8-fast vs v4.1 int8-safe on identical load.

Ben — please own the rollback execution and confirm when done. Irene — own the KV cache / memory diagnostics and attach the snapshot to the incident. I'll coordinate exec comms with the customer.

Marissa Cole
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [SilverCrow] Sudden throughput drop + p99 spike after v4.2 deploy

Status update: rollback executed at 10:12 PT yesterday. Steps performed:
- Traffic override applied to pin SilverCrow to v4.1 (hotpath) via policy ID override-3347.
- Verified model containers replaced and KV caches warmed from snapshot.
- Observed p99 drop from ~1.4s to ~360ms over a 25m stabilization window. Error 500s reduced from ~0.6% to ~0.02%. Throughput recovered to ~93% of pre-deploy baseline.

Attachments: redwood_telemetry_snapshot_20260310.json (telemetry taken at 10:40 PT) and brief runbook excerpt (rollback_runbook_v4.1.pdf).

Next steps:
1) Deeper performance profiling to find cause of int8-fast regression (narrowed suspect: decoder kernel scheduling on the 80GB cards under packed batches).
2) QA a canary of v4.2 with int8-safe profile in a controlled environment before reattempting customer rollout.
3) Prepare RCA draft and customer credit proposal.

Ben Carter
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_telemetry_snapshot_20260310.json (48KB)]
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@silvercrow.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.reynolds@silvercrow.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [SilverCrow] Sudden throughput drop + p99 spike after v4.2 deploy

Thanks everyone — confirming we see the same improvement on our dashboards after you pinned us to v4.1. Checkout p99 is back to ~350–380ms and error rate is down. Throughput is still ~7% below the historical average but we can live with that short-term.

Please provide:
- A short RCA that explains the int8-fast behavior vs int8-safe and the timeline.
- Proposed timeline for revalidation / re-rollout and whether QA will include multi-tenant stress tests.
- Credit proposal for the downtime window (we lost revenue).

Appreciate the quick action. We'll plan a postmortem call tomorrow at 09:00 PT.

Aisha
